unknown_behavior: Reject unknown fields and union branches before execution with invalid_request or the closest stable unsupported_* code.

request_fields.name: model
request_fields.semantics: Required non-empty server model ID or controlled alias.
request_fields.error_behavior: Missing or mismatched values fail before execution.

request_fields.name: input
request_fields.semantics: Text string or supported typed item array; at least input or instructions is required.

request_fields.name: instructions
request_fields.semantics: Independent system message.

request_fields.name: stream
request_fields.semantics: Boolean selects JSON or SSE projection.

request_fields.name: max_output_tokens
request_fields.semantics: Caps all generated tokens.

request_fields.name: temperature
request_fields.semantics: Validated; effective only when current-turn thinking is disabled.
request_fields.error_behavior: Out-of-range or wrong type is invalid_request.

request_fields.name: top_p
request_fields.semantics: Validated; effective only when current-turn thinking is disabled.
request_fields.error_behavior: Out-of-range or wrong type is invalid_request.

request_fields.name: tools
request_fields.semantics: Function tools and apply_patch custom tool only.
request_fields.error_behavior: Unsupported type or tool fails before execution.

request_fields.name: tool_choice
request_fields.semantics: none, auto, required, named function, or apply_patch.
request_fields.error_behavior: Unknown or unavailable choice is invalid_request or unknown_tool.

request_fields.name: parallel_tool_calls
request_fields.semantics: Accepted only as true and response behavior is always true.
request_fields.evidence: spec D20 and model-catalog Codex capture

request_fields.name: reasoning.effort
request_fields.semantics: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max; profile maps effective value.

request_fields.name: reasoning.summary
request_fields.semantics: Only the captured value auto is accepted and normalized to no summary.

request_fields.name: store
request_fields.semantics: Missing or false normalizes to false.

request_fields.name: previous_response_id
request_fields.semantics: Missing or null only; service remains stateless.

request_fields.name: include
request_fields.semantics: Only [reasoning.encrypted_content] is accepted for Codex compatibility; no encrypted content is produced.

request_fields.name: prompt_cache_key
request_fields.semantics: Non-empty bounded string is accepted but xLLM assigns no cache identity semantics.
request_fields.error_behavior: Wrong type or oversize value is invalid_request.

request_fields.name: client_metadata
request_fields.semantics: A bounded opaque object is accepted and discarded; nested keys may evolve without acquiring server-side semantics.
request_fields.error_behavior: Non-object values are invalid_request and objects over the metadata byte limit are request_too_large; unknown top-level request fields remain unsupported_parameter.

request_fields.name: text.verbosity
request_fields.semantics: Captured low value is accepted without changing decoding.
request_fields.error_behavior: Other text fields or values are unsupported_parameter.

request_fields.name: metadata
request_fields.semantics: No server-side metadata semantics.

request_fields.name: conversation
request_fields.semantics: No conversation store.

request_fields.name: background
request_fields.semantics: Only synchronous request lifetime.

request_fields.name: truncation
request_fields.semantics: History is never silently truncated.

request_fields.name: user
request_fields.semantics: No user attribution field in the frozen subset.
request_fields.evidence: spec fixture-driven rule; absent from capture

request_fields.name: n
request_fields.semantics: Single sequence only.

request_fields.name: best_of
request_fields.semantics: Single sequence only.

request_fields.name: beam_width
request_fields.semantics: Single sequence only.

request_fields.name: max_tokens
request_fields.semantics: Alias is not accepted; use max_output_tokens.

request_fields.name: presence_penalty
request_fields.semantics: Sampling parameter is outside the strict subset.

request_fields.name: frequency_penalty
request_fields.semantics: Sampling parameter is outside the strict subset.

request_fields.name: reasoning.encrypted_content
request_fields.semantics: Encrypted reasoning is not accepted as request configuration.

input_items.name: message
input_items.semantics: user, assistant, system, and developer text messages.
input_items.error_behavior: Unknown role or content is invalid_request.

input_items.name: reasoning
input_items.semantics: Plain reasoning_text content is retained and replayed.
input_items.error_behavior: Summary or encrypted payload outside frozen forms is unsupported_parameter.

input_items.name: reasoning.encrypted_content:null
input_items.semantics: Null replay member is accepted; encrypted payloads are rejected.

input_items.name: reasoning.summary:[]
input_items.semantics: Empty replay array is accepted; summary content is rejected.

input_items.name: function_call
input_items.semantics: Historical non-strict function call with object arguments string.

input_items.name: function_call_output
input_items.error_behavior: Unknown or mismatched call_id fails closed.

input_items.name: custom_tool_call
input_items.semantics: Historical apply_patch call with raw text input.

input_items.name: custom_tool_call_output
input_items.semantics: Text output linked to an apply_patch call_id.
input_items.error_behavior: Unknown or mismatched call_id fails closed.

input_items.name: additional_tools
input_items.semantics: Code-mode tool bundles are outside the strict subset.
input_items.evidence: Codex 0.147.0 default code-mode capture; compatible capture disables code_mode_host

output_items.name: message
output_items.error_behavior: Encoder rejects invalid internal item state.

output_items.name: reasoning
output_items.semantics: Plain reasoning_text content; no summary or encryption.

output_items.name: function_call
output_items.semantics: Name, call_id, and complete JSON-object arguments.

output_items.name: custom_tool_call
output_items.semantics: apply_patch name, call_id, and raw input.

content_parts.name: input_text
content_parts.error_behavior: Invalid UTF-8 or oversize content fails before execution.

content_parts.name: output_text
content_parts.semantics: Assistant text in explicit history and output.

content_parts.name: reasoning_text
content_parts.semantics: Plain reasoning content used for replay.

content_parts.name: refusal
content_parts.semantics: Refusal parts are not a separate phase 0-5 content type.

content_parts.name: input_file
content_parts.semantics: Files are outside the text-only subset.

content_parts.name: input_audio
content_parts.semantics: Audio is outside the text-only subset.

content_parts.name: video
content_parts.semantics: Video is outside the text-only subset.

tools.name: function
tools.semantics: Named non-strict function with bounded JSON Schema object.

tools.name: function.strict=false
tools.semantics: Missing or false normalizes to non-strict.

tools.name: custom.apply_patch
tools.evidence: Codex request 1 and executed custom call

tools.name: custom.description
tools.semantics: The bounded captured description is accepted but is not authoritative.
tools.error_behavior: Wrong type or oversize value is invalid_request.

tools.name: custom.format.grammar
tools.semantics: The exact captured apply_patch Lark grammar is accepted; profile prompt codecs remain authoritative.
tools.error_behavior: Other syntax, definition, or tool is unsupported_parameter.

tools.name: custom.other
tools.semantics: No other custom tools are supported.

tool_choice.name: auto
tool_choice.semantics: Model may select a declared tool.

tool_choice.name: required
tool_choice.semantics: Require a tool call when tools are present.

tool_choice.name: named_function
tool_choice.semantics: Select a function declared in this request.

response_fields.name: error
response_fields.semantics: Null on success; stable error on failure.

response_fields.name: reasoning
response_fields.semantics: Echoes effective effort and null summary.

response_fields.name: usage
response_fields.semantics: Reliable input, output, cached, reasoning, and total tokens.
response_fields.error_behavior: Missing reliable final usage is generation_failed.

sse_events.name: response.output_item.added
sse_events.error_behavior: Never emitted before type is known.

sse_events.name: response.output_item.done
sse_events.error_behavior: Never emitted for an incomplete call.

sse_events.name: response.reasoning_text.done
sse_events.error_behavior: Not emitted for an incomplete item.

sse_events.name: response.output_text.done
sse_events.error_behavior: Not emitted for an incomplete item.

sse_events.name: response.function_call_arguments.delta
sse_events.semantics: Raw arguments delta after call classification.

sse_events.name: response.function_call_arguments.done
sse_events.error_behavior: Invalid JSON omits done and fails response.
sse_events.evidence: Codex scripted capture and spec D28

sse_events.name: response.custom_tool_call_input.done
sse_events.error_behavior: Not emitted for an incomplete call.

sse_events.name: response.completed
sse_events.semantics: Only normal terminal event; carries final response.
sse_events.error_behavior: Mutually exclusive with incomplete and failed.

sse_events.name: response.incomplete
sse_events.error_behavior: Mutually exclusive with completed and failed.

sse_events.name: response.failed
sse_events.error_behavior: Mutually exclusive with completed and incomplete.

sse_events.name: error
sse_events.semantics: Generic SSE error event is not used after streaming starts.

sse_events.name: [DONE]
sse_events.semantics: No sentinel replaces the formal terminal event.

errors.name: unsupported_parameter
errors.semantics: Known but unavailable parameter or value.

errors.name: unsupported_item_type
errors.semantics: Known but unavailable item union branch.

errors.name: model_mismatch
errors.semantics: Requested model does not match the deployment binding.

errors.name: tool_call_type_mismatch
errors.semantics: Output type differs from call type.

errors.name: invalid_item_order
errors.semantics: Assistant grouping or pending-call ordering is invalid.

errors.name: invalid_tool_arguments
errors.semantics: Function arguments are not a complete JSON object.
errors.error_behavior: HTTP 400 for history or response.failed after stream start.

errors.name: request_too_large
errors.semantics: Body or aggregate payload exceeds limits.

errors.name: too_many_items
errors.semantics: Item or tool count exceeds limits.

errors.name: generation_failed
errors.error_behavior: HTTP error before stream or response.failed after start.

errors.name: request_cancelled
errors.semantics: Request cancelled before a writable terminal.
errors.error_behavior: HTTP error or internal cleanup without wire event after disconnect.

errors.name: request_timeout
errors.error_behavior: HTTP error or response.failed according to stream state.

errors.name: client_too_slow
errors.error_behavior: Cancel generation and emit response.failed when writable.
